description: Compose a transaction to mint tokens from an active fair minter

inputs_set.description: Comma-separated UTXOs to use as inputs (txid:vout)

quantity.description: Raw integer amount to mint. For divisible: human amount * 10^8. If omitted, mints max allowed.

sat_per_vbyte.description: Fee rate in satoshis per virtual byte (e.g. 1, 5.5, 0.15). Check get_fee_estimate for current market rates.

name: compose_fairmint
